cases.name: Verify protocol modification and saving in Edit link window

cases.condition: Merchant has entered My Shop → Links → Edit link window

steps.desc: 1. Click the edit button of an existing Link
2. Change the protocol dropdown to https / mailto / tel / sms
steps.result: 2. Dropdown correctly displays the modified protocol

steps.desc: 3. Modify the input field with a valid URL, email, or number
steps.result: 3. Input value is accepted without error
4. System saves successfully and returns to Links list, new Link shows protocol + address correctly

cases.name: After verifying that Curator deletes 2 Links, the count in the upper right corner of Links is updated together with the number of My shop-Links.
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Links

steps.desc: 1.Curator enters My shop-Links 2. Click the trash can icon of the first two links 3. Click "Delete" in the Delete link 4. Check the count in the upper right corner of Links and the number of My shop-Links
steps.result: Curator successfully deleted 2 Links. The count in the upper right corner of Links is updated together with the number of My shop-Links.

cases.name: Verify shop-level global Link card style configuration is removed
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Links
cases.condition: Merchant is on the Customize shop -> Storefront tab

steps.desc: 1. Scroll down to the bottom section where "Product card style" is located.
steps.result: 1. The page renders normally and still displays the "Product card style" configuration.

steps.desc: 2. Check for the old "Link card style" radio button block.
steps.result: 2. The old shop-level "Link card style" radio button section is completely hidden/deprecated and no longer visible to the merchant.

cases.name: Verify default style and layout switching logic when creating a new General Link
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Links
cases.condition: Merchant clicks "+ Add new" on the Links list page to create a General Link

steps.desc: 1. Observe the "Link card layout" configuration section at the bottom of the popup modal.
steps.result: 1. The new "Link card layout" module is present, and the "Compact" layout is selected by default.

steps.desc: 2. Switch the radio button choice to "Compact" and check the subtext below it.
steps.result: 2. The selection seamlessly switches to "Large", displaying its corresponding description text ("Clean, minimal layout...") below it.

steps.desc: 3. Complete all required fields and click "Add" to save.
steps.result: 3. The new General Link is successfully saved without any console or UI errors.

cases.name: Verify storefront rendering consistency for different link styles
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Links
cases.condition: The shop has both a "Large" styled link and a "Compact" styled link active

steps.desc: 1. Open the public storefront URL (pear.us/...) as a Guest Buyer.
steps.result: 1. The storefront page loads completely and smoothly.

steps.desc: 2. Inspect the UI layouts of the two configured General Links.
steps.result: 2. Both link cards render independently based on their individual settings: the link configured as Large shows the full image block, while the one set to Compact presents the slim/minimalist layout.
